Source: Original French Amiga Populous II native options and deity widget bodies
OptionsScope: $471c..$47f4 actual compilation, side/rule-word selection, speed/checkbox glyph mutation, font draw and swap. Both sides and all 1,024 low-bit rule combinations; speeds span 0..17.
DeityScope: Actual $baa8 opaque background writes and $bb3a complete 12-strip XP compositor. All 512 face-part combinations and all 256 XP bytes per category. Face direct-blitter submissions retain source-bank identification and X/Y/size. OS blitter locks and DMA color output are outside the CPU oracle.
